atoms.text: Nikola Tesla was born in 1856 in Smiljan, Croatia. He was a gifted scientist and made many important scientific discoveries about electricity and power.
atoms.sound: Nikola Tesla was born in 1856 in Smil-yan, Croatia. He was a gifted scientist, and made many important scientific discoveries about electricity and power.

hint.text: Croatia is a country in Southern Europe.
hint.label: Croatia

atoms.text: When he was in his early twenties, Nikola moved to New York. Unfortunately, he had a hard time and did not always get the recognition he deserved. In 1895, Nikola’s lab in New York burned down. The fire destroyed years of notes and important equipment.

Nikola Tesla died in 1943. After his death, he was recognised for his important discoveries in electrical energy and radio. Nikola Tesla’s work was important for science. We still use his ideas about power today.
